name: @pipeworx/mcp-de-gesetze

tools.name: gesetze_search
tools.description: Search German federal statutes and ordinances (Gesetze im Internet, BMJ/juris) BY TITLE OR ABBREVIATION — "BGB", "StGB", "Datenschutz", "Straßenverkehr". An exact or near abbreviation match (BGB, StGB, HGB, BDSG, GG…) returns that one law directly; otherwise ranks law titles by word overlap. Returns each match's abbreviation and official title. Use for "what is the abbreviation for the German Civil Code" or "find the German data protection act". Keyless.

limit.description: Max results, default 10, max 25 (ignored on an exact abbreviation match).

tools.name: gesetze_law_info
tools.description: Amendment metadata ("Stand") for a German federal law or ordinance: official abbreviation and title, date of promulgation (Ausfertigungsdatum), official publication citation (Fundstelle), the official amendment-status entries (Neufassung/Stand — the act and date that produced the current consolidated text), and the entry-into-force date when Gesetze im Internet publishes one. Use for "what is the current Stand of the BGB" or "when was the current BDSG enacted". Keyless.

law.description: The law or ordinance: its official abbreviation ("BGB", "StGB", "HGB", "BDSG", "GG", "ZPO", "EStG") or (if unambiguous) its official title ("Bürgerliches Gesetzbuch"). Call gesetze_search first if unsure.

tools.name: gesetze_structure
tools.description: Table of contents of a German federal law or ordinance (Bücher/Abschnitte/Titel/Kapitel) with the §/Art. provisions listed under each heading, from Gesetze im Internet. `depth` controls how many heading levels come back; pass a `section_id` from a previous answer to expand one branch. A branch with more provisions than `provision_limit` says so (`has_more_provisions`) rather than truncating silently. Use to browse a law's structure or list the provisions of one chapter.

law.description: The law or ordinance: its official abbreviation ("BGB", "StGB", "HGB", "BDSG", "GG", "ZPO", "EStG") or (if unambiguous) its official title ("Bürgerliches Gesetzbuch"). Call gesetze_search first if unsure.

section_id.description: Optional structural-heading id (Gliederungskennzahl) from a previous gesetze_structure answer, to expand one branch.

depth.description: Heading levels to return below the starting point, 1-8 (default 2).

provision_limit.description: Max provisions listed per heading before has_more_provisions, 10-400 (default 100).

tools.name: gesetze_provision
tools.description: Full text of a single § (Paragraph) or Art. (Artikel) of a German federal law or ordinance, by abbreviation and provision number, from Gesetze im Internet. Accepts natural forms: "823", "§ 823", "823a", "Art 1", "Art. 1". Returns the provision's title, full original-language (German) text, and its own footnote (amendment/application note) when the source attaches one. Use for "what does § 823 BGB say" or "Art 1 GG". Keyless.

law.description: The law or ordinance: its official abbreviation ("BGB", "StGB", "HGB", "BDSG", "GG", "ZPO", "EStG") or (if unambiguous) its official title ("Bürgerliches Gesetzbuch"). Call gesetze_search first if unsure.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-de-gesetze forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the de-gesetze pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
